fee_notes: Standard single-unit Initial Franchise Fee is $59,000, non-refundable. A 25% discount is offered to qualified honorably discharged U.S. Military veterans via the IFA VetFran Program. Existing franchisees purchasing an additional franchise pay a reduced fee of $25,000. During fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, collected Initial Franchise Fees ranged from $25,000 to $59,000. A $25,000 Reservation Agreement payment is credited against the full fee, with $34,000 balance due at signing. Conversion Franchisees receive a discounted fee based on prior gross receipts (5% discount per $200,000 in gross receipts, up to 50% off, i.e., minimum $29,500).
raw_excerpt: Initial Franchise Fee. Upon signing the Franchise Agreement, you must pay to us an Initial Franchise Fee in the amount of $59,000. The Initial Franchise Fee is fully earned upon receipt and non-refundable... During our fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, we collected Initial Franchise Fees that ranged from $25,000 to $59,000.
